verdict.rationale: pnpm docs show strong non-interactive CI support: it auto-switches to frozen-lockfile mode in CI (pnpm-docs-13), can run offline and fail if a package isn't cached (pnpm-docs-10), and supports dry-run resolution without writing to disk (pnpm-docs-9/19), all of which support scriptable/agent-driven install and update flows. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents exit-code conventions or structured error output for install/update failures, and community threads focus on speed/monorepo experience rather than confirming non-interactive error handling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes on failure, structured/error-message clarity for CI/agent consumption, and independent confirmation of non-interactive update behavior.
